question: What is the registration fee for Zinnia 2026?
variations: Do I need to pay to participate?
How much is the ticket price?
answer: The registration fee for Zinnia 2026 is ₹150 per participant. This single fee grants you complete access to compete in technical and non-technical events, a welcome symposium kit, complimentary lunch & refreshments, and official Anna University recognized participation certificates.

question: When is the registration deadline?
variations: Can I register on the spot?
What is the registration end date?
answer: Online pre-registration closes 24 hours prior to the symposium date. On-the-spot registrations are also available at the campus registration desk on the event morning from 8:30 AM to 9:30 AM, subject to seat availability.

question: Who is eligible to participate in Zinnia 2026?
variations: Can students from any department join?
Are arts and science students eligible?
Is it open to PG students?
answer: All undergraduate (B.E. / B.Tech) and postgraduate (M.E. / M.Tech / MCA / M.Sc) engineering and technology students from recognized colleges and universities are eligible. A valid college ID card is mandatory for campus entry and verification.

question: Where is the symposium venue?
answer: Zinnia 2026 is hosted by the Department of Computer Science & Engineering at Government College of Engineering, Erode (formerly IRTT), located on NH-544 (Salem-Cochin Highway), Chithode, Erode - 638316, Tamil Nadu. It is easily accessible by frequent buses from Erode Central Bus Stand and Erode Junction Railway Station (approx. 14 km).

question: What is the event schedule and timing?
answer:
The day schedule is as follows:
• 08:30 AM - 09:30 AM: Registration Verification & Kit Distribution
• 09:30 AM - 10:00 AM: Grand Inaugural Ceremony (Main Auditorium)
• 10:00 AM - 01:30 PM: Technical & Non-Technical Competitions
• 01:00 PM - 02:00 PM: Lunch & Networking Break
• 02:30 PM - 03:30 PM: Valedictory Ceremony & Cash Prize Distribution.

question: Is food provided for participants?
variations: Do we get free food and snacks?
Is there lunch included in the registration fee?
answer: Yes! Complimentary South Indian buffet lunch and morning/evening refreshments are provided for all registered participants. Your digital pass (Agent ID) contains a verified food token QR code used for hassle-free meal distribution at the dining hall.

question: Is accommodation available for outstation participants?
variations: Can we stay overnight at the college?
answer: Yes, separate college hostel accommodation for boys and girls is available upon prior request on a nominal charge basis for outstation participants traveling long distances. Please contact the hospitality coordinators at least 2 days prior to the event to reserve your stay.

question: Will all participants receive certificates?
variations: Do I get a participation certificate?
answer: Yes, all attending participants who verify entry and compete in events will receive official Certificates of Participation recognized under Anna University. Winners of 1st, 2nd, and 3rd positions will receive Certificates of Merit along with their cash awards and trophies during the Valedictory function.

question: What are the prizes and awards?
variations: What is the total prize pool?
How much cash prize will winners get?
What rewards are given for winning?
answer: Zinnia 2026 features a total prize pool exceeding ₹30,000+! Each technical and non-technical event awards cash prizes for 1st (up to ₹6,000 for Infinity Protocol, ₹3,000-₹3,500 for other events), 2nd (₹2,000-₹4,000), and 3rd positions (₹1,000-₹2,000), along with prestigious shields, medals, and merit badges.

question: What events are available at Zinnia 2026?
variations: How many events can I attend?
answer:
Zinnia 2026 features 9 national-level competitions:

• Technical Events (5):
1. MSN-01: Operation System Recovery (Debugging)
2. MSN-02: Operation ORACLE (AI & Prompt Engineering)
3. MSN-03: Operation Broken Records (SQL Mastery)
4. MSN-04: Operation Infinity Protocol (Grand Marathon Hackathon)
5. MSN-05: Operation Mission Control (UI/UX Design)

• Non-Technical Events (4):
6. MSN-06: Borderland at GCE (Campus Mystery Treasure Hunt)
7. MSN-07: Think, Strike and Win (Fast-Paced Quiz)
8. MSN-08: Plot Twist (Impromptu Storytelling)
9. MSN-09: Short Film (Cinematic Showcase)

question: What is the allowed team size for events?
variations: Can I participate alone or in a team?
What is the minimum and maximum team members?
Do I need a team to register?
answer:
Team sizes vary by event:
• Individual (1) or Duo (2): System Recovery, ORACLE AI, Broken Records (SQL), Mission Control (UI/UX), Plot Twist
• Teams of 2 to 3: Infinity Protocol, Think Strike & Win
• Teams of 2 to 4: Borderland at GCE
• Teams of 1 to 5: Short Film

You can register individually or with your squad mates.

question: What is the Digital Passport / Agent ID?
variations: How do I get my entry pass?
Where do I download my ticket/pass?
How does attendance and food check-in work?
answer: Upon completing registration on the website (/register), you are instantly assigned a unique holographic Agent ID (e.g. ZIN26-A8F41C) and Digital Passport. This pass contains encrypted QR codes for campus security entry, event check-ins, and food redemption.

question: What are the general rules and dress code?
answer:
General Guidelines:
1. Decent formal or smart casual attire is required.
2. College ID cards are strictly mandatory.
3. Laptops are encouraged for technical events (UI/UX, Infinity Protocol, Debugging) with charging ports provided.
4. Maintain discipline and respect campus property.
5. Decision of the judging panel and jury will be final.

question: Can I register for multiple events?
variations: Can I participate in more than one event?
How many events can one person attend?
Can I join both tech and non-tech events?
answer: Yes! A single ₹150 registration fee allows you to register for multiple non-clashing events. However, single-event exclusive tracks like 'Operation Infinity Protocol' run continuously across morning sessions and cannot be combined with other morning technical rounds.
